content:
maya-peopleops: Quick heads-up — launching 'Week of Thanks' care package + local voucher redemption flow. Goal: hybrid-friendly, keep tax paperwork minimal.
tara-peopleops: Love it. Are we doing physical kits for US only and vouchers for everyone else?
maya-peopleops: Yes. US: physical kit (snack + pin + note). Intl: $25 voucher code to local vendor or e-gift.
oli-recomp: Need to flag VAT/GST handling for APAC/EU for vouchers. Treasury asked about reporting if >$600 local.
ryan-ops: Vendor slots: we have 650 US kits on hand, supplier says restock in 10 days if we order by Friday.
emma-remote: For distributed folks, can we offer shipping to work address or pickup hub? A lot of vendors won't ship P.O. boxes.
tara-peopleops: Pickup hubs ok. We should allow 'donate' option too (swap to charity donation instead of kit).
oli-recomp: Spreadsheet columns we need from people: 
```
employee_id,country,kit_type,ship_address,ship_by,personal_phone,cost_usd,tax_flag
```
maya-peopleops: Perfect. I'll add a short form and pre-fill employee_id + country via HRIS export.
ryan-ops: Shipping labels — please include only first name + last initial for privacy when sending to home addresses.
kudos-bot: :calendar: Reminder: order cutoff in 72 hours (automated check tomorrow at 09:00 PST).
tara-peopleops: Communication plan draft: manager email today -> all-company reminder Mon -> RSVP form closes Thu -> fulfillment week after.
emma-remote: For vouchers, which provider? LocalGift or UnifiedE-gift? LocalGift has better currency coverage.
oli-recomp: LocalGift fine. Finance needs the vendor W-9 equivalent for US and VAT invoices for EU.
maya-peopleops: Action items: 
- tara: finalize comms copy (today)
- oli: vendor invoice + tax guidance (EOD Thu)
- ryan: confirm shipping labels + pickup hubs (tomorrow)
- emma: QA voucher redemption flow (this week)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you have each item. I'll compile a manager snippet for heads to announce.
